name: Tomarang
blurb: Grown from humble roots off the coast of Shih Sea, Tomarang is lively with local fare, community chaos, and legends of lore. Known for its tight-knit communities and sun-filled shared spaces, Tomarang is a lush landscape of possibilities.

neighbourhoods.name: Morensong
neighbourhoods.desc: A bustling neighbourhood with pockets of idyllic peace and nooks of neighbourly nuance! Morensong is the spot for vibrant communities to thrive, day or night.

neighbourhoods.name: Koh Sahpa
neighbourhoods.desc: Neighbours with nature or other tenants, Koh Sahpa offers a more relaxed lifestyle along the river.

weather: No snow, monsoons in autumn, plenty of rain

highlights.name: Night Market
highlights.text: Visit the famous Tomarang Night Market for some after-dark shopping and mouth-watering cuisine!

highlights.name: Local Living
highlights.text: Embrace community and take a minute to get to know the local neighbors. Poke for local gossip, join in a game of marbles, and enjoy the warmth of this tight knit locale.

highlights.name: Rich History
highlights.text: Dive into the lore of the land and discover hidden secrets, historical battles, and legendary tails.
